description: This file defines a Subcontracting class with methods for managing raw materials, transfer, validation, and consumption related to subcontracting processes in an ERP system, specifically handling purchase orders, receipts, invoices, and BOMs.

classes.name: Subcontracting
classes.description: Class managing subcontracting operations including material transfer, validation, and consumption in ERP workflows.

methods.name: set_materials_for_subcontracted_items
methods.description: Main method to set and process materials for subcontracted items based on document type and stock update status.

methods.name: __prepare_supplied_items
methods.description: Prepares supplied items by initializing fields, fetching purchase orders, and setting supplied items.

methods.name: initialized_fields
methods.description: Initializes internal dictionaries and fetches backflush configuration.

methods.name: __get_backflush_based_on
methods.description: Retrieves backflush configuration from system settings.

methods.name: __get_purchase_orders
methods.description: Fetches purchase orders related to current items.

methods.name: __identify_change_in_item_table
methods.description: Detects changes in item table compared to previous document state.

methods.name: __get_data_before_save
methods.description: Retrieves item data from the document's previous saved state.

methods.name: get_available_materials
methods.description: Calculates available raw materials transferred to the supplier.

methods.name: __update_consumed_materials
methods.description: Deducts consumed materials from available stock based on receipts or invoices.

methods.name: __get_transferred_items
methods.description: Fetches stock entry details related to transfer of materials.

methods.name: __get_received_items
methods.description: Fetches purchase receipt or invoice items.

methods.name: __get_consumed_items
methods.description: Fetches items that have been consumed from purchase receipts.

methods.name: __set_alternative_item_details
methods.description: Stores details of original items for alternative item handling.

methods.name: __get_pending_qty_to_receive
methods.description: Calculates quantity pending to be received for purchase orders.

methods.name: __get_materials_from_bom
methods.description: Fetches BOM items and their quantities for material calculation.

methods.name: __remove_changed_rows
methods.description: Removes rows that have changed since last save from supplied items.

methods.name: __set_supplied_items
methods.description: Sets supplied items based on BOM or transfer data.

methods.name: __update_reserve_warehouse
methods.description: Updates reserve warehouse info for BOM items.

methods.name: __get_qty_based_on_material_transfer
methods.description: Calculates transfer quantity based on pending quantities.

methods.name: __set_alternative_item
methods.description: Updates BOM item with alternative item details if available.

methods.name: __add_supplied_item
methods.description: Adds a supplied item to the raw material table.

methods.name: __set_batch_nos
methods.description: Assigns batch numbers to items based on available stock.

methods.name: __set_consumed_qty
methods.description: Sets consumed quantity and required quantity on item objects.

methods.name: __set_batch_no_as_per_qty
methods.description: Sets batch number and quantities for items.

methods.name: __set_serial_nos
methods.description: Assigns serial numbers to items and updates available serials.

methods.name: set_consumed_qty_in_po
methods.description: Updates consumed quantities back into purchase orders.

methods.name: __update_consumed_qty_in_po
methods.description: Writes back consumed quantities into purchase order items.

methods.name: __validate_supplied_items
methods.description: Validates supplied items for serial, batch, and quantity correctness.

methods.name: __validate_consumed_qty
methods.description: Checks that consumed quantity is not zero.

methods.name: __validate_batch_no
methods.description: Validates batch number correctness against transfer data.

methods.name: __validate_serial_no
methods.description: Validates serial number correctness against transfer data.
